hero.title: Build the factory that never sleeps.
hero.subtitle: We engineer vision, motion, and decisioning into a single platform that runs production lines without a human in the loop. From inspection to assembly to logistics — designed for the lights-out era.

capabilities.title: Six engines that make a lights-out line possible.
capabilities.subtitle: Vision, robotics, and AI engineered together — not bolted on.

vision.title: Sub-pixel machine vision
vision.body: Custom optics, multi-spectral lighting, and PatMax-class geometric matching that resolves defects below 5 microns at line speed.

ai.title: On-device defect AI
ai.body: Self-supervised models trained per SKU, redeployed in minutes. Zero cloud dependency on the line.

motion.title: Closed-loop motion
motion.body: Six-axis robots, linear stages, and force-feedback grippers tuned to micrometer-level repeatability.

metrology.title: In-line metrology
metrology.body: Confocal, structured light, and laser interferometry fused into one measurement record per part.

data.title: Factory data fabric
data.body: Every part, every cycle, time-locked into an OPC-UA / MQTT data fabric with full lineage.

ops.title: Lights-out operations
ops.body: Self-recovery, auto-rebalancing across stations, and zero-touch SKU changeover.

lightsOut.title: From automated inspection to fully autonomous production.
lightsOut.subtitle: Most factories still need humans every shift. Dinnar gives you the platform to remove them — safely, gradually, line by line.

phaseAutomate.title: 1 · Automate
phaseAutomate.body: Replace manual inspection and measurement with deterministic vision systems.

phaseConnect.title: 2 · Connect
phaseConnect.body: Link every station into one data fabric. Every defect is correlated, every cycle is measured.

phaseDecide.title: 3 · Decide
phaseDecide.body: Closed-loop AI that resolves micro-stoppages, rebalances throughput, and orders re-work without an operator.

phaseLightsOut.title: 4 · Lights-Out
phaseLightsOut.body: Switch off the lights. Production continues, recovers, and reports — autonomously.

industries.title: Built for the world's hardest production problems.
industries.subtitle: Deployed across consumer electronics, EV batteries, semiconductors, and displays.

electron.title: 3C Consumer Electronics
electron.summary: Phones, laptops, wearables — appearance, dimension, and functional inspection at line speed.
electron.longDescription: From the world's largest consumer electronics OEMs to their tier-one suppliers, Dinnar systems inspect mobile camera modules, laptop housings, watch back covers, PCB assemblies, and microphone cavities. We sustain >99.97% recall on cosmetic defects below 30 microns while keeping cycle time under one second per part.
highlights: Camera module color and full-dimension inspection
Laptop appearance and BC/TC/DH dimension measurement
Watch back cover light-pass and bonding inspection

energy.title: New Energy & Automotive
energy.summary: Battery cells, modules, glass, and drive components — built for high-mix, high-throughput EV lines.
energy.longDescription: EV battery cells, prismatic and pouch, demand zero-defect appearance and dimension control. Dinnar lines handle composite separator film, H1H2 lithium cells, windshield-to-PVD-film alignment, and door-lock assembly with deterministic guarantees.
highlights: Prismatic and pouch cell appearance inspection

semiconductor.title: Semiconductor
semiconductor.summary: Wafer, die, and substrate-level inspection and assembly with sub-micron repeatability.
semiconductor.longDescription: Wafer cutting blade inspection, sensor assembly, and motor-housing tap-and-drill systems handle the most demanding tolerances in the industry. Our integrated thermal and vibration compensation keeps measurements stable through full shifts.

display.title: Display Panels
display.summary: Mini-LED, OLED, and LCD inspection from glue to backlight to lit-pixel.
display.longDescription: End-to-end coverage from Mini-LED glue defect detection through backlight contour measurement to LCD lit-screen metrology. Custom optics suppress moiré and resolve sub-pixel anomalies at production line speed.

other.title: Medical & Industrial
other.summary: Surgical staplers, saline bottles, and precision mechanical parts — built to medical and ISO standards.
other.longDescription: Medical surgical-stapler staple cartridge inspection, saline-bottle defect detection, and universal-joint cross-shaft appearance inspection — engineered to ISO 13485 / GMP grade with full audit trail per part.

products.title: ACI-S1000 + Vision One.
products.subtitle: One controller, one model trainer, every line.
products.flagshipBody: ACI-S1000 is the brain of every Dinnar line: a unified controller that orchestrates vision, motion, and AI inference at sub-millisecond cadence. Vision One is the development platform engineers use to design, train, and deploy inspection models without writing low-level code.
aciHighlights: Hot-swap line modules with zero downtime
visionHighlights: Deploys to ACI-S1000 in one click

tech.title: The numbers behind a lights-out line.

ome.title: We build the stack other automation companies stop short of.
ome.subtitle: Most vendors integrate. We engineer.

optics.title: Optics
optics.body: Custom telecentric lenses, multi-spectral coaxial lighting, and proprietary polariser stacks tuned per SKU. Designed in-house, ground in-house.

mechanics.title: Mechanics
mechanics.body: Granite stages, precision linear modules, and vibration-isolated work cells engineered for sub-micron repeatability over 8-year service life.

electronics.title: Electronics
electronics.body: ACI-S1000 baseboards, FPGA imaging cards, and EtherCAT motion controllers. Every PCBA is built and tested by Dinnar.

about.title: Engineered in San Jose. Deployed worldwide.
about.body: Dinnar Automatic Intelligence Inc. is the U.S. operating company building the lights-out manufacturing platform for the next generation of factories. Our team comes from the world's leading vision, robotics, and AI labs, and our systems run production lines for Fortune 500 consumer electronics, EV, battery, and semiconductor manufacturers across three continents.
about.missionBody: To build the platform that runs the world's first fully lights-out factories — safer, more accurate, and more sustainable than any human-led line.
